reviewer_statement: Scoped source scientific data and plotting-artist developer review. Native R registered trajectories/warp geometry and direct pinned Python 1.2 source artist comparisons are committed. Exact-head differential CI and external certification are not yet verified; native R cannot return Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure instances.
native_language_semantic_policy: Only observed scientific line coordinates, figure panel count/metadata, source labels/opacity and source identity/displacement definitions are represented. The native base graphics object is not Python Matplotlib, and exception/axes mutation/pixel parity remain out of scope.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_registration. No R implementation reuses Python runtime plotting classes.

Requires real native landmark registration with identical original and registered time grids, curve IDs and named dimension; positive integer max_curves selects first N. Strict source mode requires a nonmissing logical scalar; Python source permits max_curves=0 edge while this native accepted domain is explicitly positive only.

Two panels titled Original/Registered; native original and fitted registered source values for every selected original curve are preserved, with exact x=time, y=source scientific values, alpha=0.25 per line, original curve order, source time unit axes and Python figure size intent (10,4). Direct frozen Python 1.2 public (fig,axes) plot lines, opacity and figure size tests committed.

Unsupported result class, incomplete warps, mismatched original/registered grids or curve IDs, unknown dimension, nonpositive max_curves and invalid strict flag fail explicitly. Python KeyError and plotting Figure runtime behavior are not reproduced.

Python returns (Matplotlib Figure, NumPy array of two Axes). R strictly returns a typed two-panel source-scientific artist record declaring that intended Python return kind, but does not create Python Axes/Figure or pixels. Default native R still returns original/registered numeric per-curve data frames.
Genuine registered and original source trajectories shown in separate panels without refitting a landmark or resampling original measurement coordinates.

independent_review_status: Author-scoped provisional scientific-geometry review; pinned Python exact-head tests queued/unverified, zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: R base graphics and source data do not recreate Python Figure/Axes runtime object identity, exceptions, or pixel-equivalent rendering.
Supported source-scientific geometry scope is restricted to complete native registration and original observed reconstruction summary; full Python input/ax domain remains different.
No independently checked numerical end-to-end registration certification, main-branch merge or CRAN qualification asserted.
